title: Signature: Identity lineage
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): one person may hold many accounts across systems; identity lineage links them with provenance: which account verified which, and when. Lineage lets a strong proofing in one system vouch for a new account in another, without repeating the full process blindly. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers linking a person's accounts with provenance.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 2, 2: 3, 3: 5}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
accts = [{"id": "acct-%d" % i, "vouched_by": "acct-%d" % (i - 1) if i else None, "ial": 2} for i in range(N)]
rooted = all(a["vouched_by"] or a["id"] == "acct-0" for a in accts)
print("accounts:", N, "| full lineage to root:", rooted)

title: Signature: Authentication transparency log
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): every authentication event (success, failure, step-up, recovery) is appended to a tamper-evident transparency log that the account owner can review. Unexpected entries are the earliest warning of compromise, and the log itself is integrity-protected. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers tamper-evident log of every auth event.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 4, 2: 8, 3: 15}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
import hashlib
log, prev = [], "GENESIS"
events = (["success"] * (N - 2)) + ["fail", "fail"] if N > 2 else ["success"] * N
for e in events:
    prev = hashlib.sha256((prev + e).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    log.append((e, prev))
fails = sum(1 for e, _ in log if e == "fail")
print("events:", N, "| failures:", fails, "| anomaly alert:", fails >= 2, "| log sealed:", log[-1][1])
